verdict.rationale: Pulumi's MCP server lets AI assistants like Claude Code and Cursor generate infrastructure code and delegate tasks to Neo, which is positioned as giving agents guardrails. `pulumi preview` and the Automation API provide a headless, non-mutating plan of proposed resource changes that an agent can run and surface. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented agent-to-human approval gate before apply, detail on the diff output format, and hands-on or independent corroboration of the end-to-end agent author→preview→approve flow.
